Three assassins hidden in the south of the world can give you their equipment. The drunk {npc:Vescu} gives you the Assassin outfit if you help him make a potion to sober up; {npc:Erayo} gives you the first addon (the head) in exchange for a lot of cloth and thread; and {npc:Atrad} gives you the second addon (the katana) for a {item:Behemoth Claw} and a {item:Nose Ring}.
Mysterious and deadly, assassins are hard to find and almost impossible to befriend.
Vescu, hut north of Port Hope
No minimum level, but level 100+ is recommended for collecting the items.
For the katana addon, you must have the head addon (Erayo) first.
Be **drunk** to talk to Vescu, **invisible** to enter Erayo's hut and **on fire** to talk to Atrad.

To reach Erayo and Atrad: parts *Access to Meriana* (turtles to the Laguna Islands), *Access to Goroma* and *The Counterspell* (Goroma energy wall) of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest}.
or Heavy Machete, to enter Vescu's hut
or Mead, Wine or Rum, to get drunk
or the Invisible spell, to enter Erayo's hut
Collect **all** the items before talking to the NPCs: you save a lot of time.

Where to get the outfit items: {item:Bonelord Eye|Bonelord Eyes} from {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} or {creature:Braindeath|Braindeaths}; {item:Red Dragon Scale|Red Dragon Scales} from {creature:Dragon Lord|Dragon Lords}; {item:Lizard Scale|Lizard Scales} from lizards; {item:Fish Fin|Fish Fins} from Quaras or Deeplings; {item:Vampire Dust} from {creature:Vampire|Vampires}; {item:Demon Dust} from {creature:Demon|Demons}.

The {item:Flask of Warrior's Sweat} is obtained by trading 4 {item:Warrior Helmet|Warrior Helmets} with the djinns that sell magic items in the djinn towers, or as loot from {creature:Undead Gladiator|Undead Gladiators}.

Where to get the cloths: blue from {creature:Blue Djinn|Blue Djinns} and {creature:Marid|Marids}; green from {creature:Green Djinn|Green Djinns} and {creature:Efreet|Efreets} (or buy {item:Green Tunic|Green Tunics} and trade them with {npc:Irmana}); red from {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {creature:Fury|Furies} and {creature:Barbarian Bloodwalker|Barbarian Bloodwalkers}; brown from {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and {creature:Barbarian Headsplitter|Barbarian Headsplitters}; yellow from {creature:Mummy|Mummies}; white from {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} and {creature:Spectre|Spectres}. {item:Spider Silk} comes from {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}.
1. Outfit: Vescu and the sobriety potion

The assassin {npc:Vescu} lives in a hut in the *scrublands* **north** of Port Hope: leave the city and walk north to the hut. You need a {item:Machete} (or {item:Heavy Machete}) to enter the hut, but you can also talk to him from outside. To go back, walk the same way **south** to Port Hope.
Vescu only answers if you are **drunk**. Drink {item:Beer}, {item:Mead}, {item:Wine} or {item:Rum} until you are intoxicated, and only then talk to him.
Do not use a {item:Dwarven Ring} at this point: you need to be drunk.
Say {key:hi}, {key:sober}, {key:potion} and {key:yes}. He reads his grandmother's recipe and asks whether you will help him gather the 30 bonelord eyes: say {key:yes}.
With all the items in your inventory (and drunk), hand them over one by one, saying the name of each ingredient and confirming with {key:yes}:
After the last ingredient, say {key:secret}. Vescu gives you his old assassin suit (without the head part).

The {wiki:Laguna Islands|Laguna Islands} have no harbour: you can only get there riding the {wiki:Sea Turtle|Sea Turtles} of the mermaid {npc:Marina}, and for that you need to have done the *Access to Meriana* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest} (it is what gives you permission to use the turtles). In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}, on the small peninsula southeast of the depot, and say {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes} (50 gp) to go to {wiki:Meriana|Meriana}. There, go to the shore where the turtles are and step on one: it takes you to the Laguna Islands. Use the turtles to move from island to island until you reach the **northeast** island.
To go back, do it in reverse: step on the Sea Turtles to Meriana and take Captain Waverider's boat back to Liberty Bay ({key:liberty bay}).

{npc:Erayo} lives in a small hut on the {wiki:Laguna Islands|Laguna Islands} in the **northeast**, lying in a hammock one floor below. To enter the hut you must be **invisible**: use the {spell:Invisible} spell or a {item:Stealth Ring}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again. He needs a lot of cloth to cover Thais castle.
Hand in the cloths and the thread
Hand everything over in this order, saying the word and confirming with {key:yes}:
Gather 1 {item:Behemoth Claw} (loot from {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths}) and 1 {item:Nose Ring} (loot from {creature:The Horned Fox}).

{npc:Atrad} is in {wiki:Goroma|Goroma}. In **Liberty Bay**, talk to {npc:Jack Fate} on his boat, in the harbour, and say {key:hi}, {key:goroma} and {key:yes} (500 gp). He only takes you to Goroma after you have done the *Access to Goroma* part of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest}. Atrad's hut is in the **north** of Goroma, beyond the energy wall: you only get past it after the *The Counterspell* mission of the same quest.
To go back, return to {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat in the **east** of Goroma and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}.

{npc:Atrad} is in {wiki:Goroma|Goroma}, beyond the energy wall, in an underground hut. He only talks to you if you are **on fire**: there are fire fields on the surface of Goroma, and the nearest one is **directly south** of the entrance to Atrad's hut. Step on it and go down straight away to talk to him.
The fire field takes your health while you burn. Have full health before stepping on it.
Set yourself on fire again, talk to Atrad ({key:hi}) and say {key:ring}. He keeps the two items and gives you the katana.
